description.p: 67zip opens, creates and extracts 7z, zip, tar (gz, bz2, xz, zst, lz) and other archives, and opens RAR archives and ISO/UDF disc images. Its own archive engine is written in safe Rust and runs in a sandbox, so a malicious archive cannot reach the rest of your files or the network.

ul.li: 7z with LZMA2 (multi-threaded), PPMd, BZip2, AES-256 and encrypted file names
zip with AES-256, Zip64 and Unicode names
RAR5 and older RAR archives, including solid, multi-volume and encrypted ones (reading only)
DVD and Blu-ray images: UDF and ISO 9660 (reading only)
Browse archives like folders, open and edit files inside them
Light and dark themes that follow your desktop

screenshot.caption: Creating an archive protected with a password

description.p: Opens UDF disc images (DVD, Blu-ray), makes password protection easy to find, and reads RAR archives.

ul.li: "Protect with a password" in the Add dialog, and "Add to zip with a password" menus
Optional secure deletion of originals and of decrypted temporary copies
Security hardening after a review and a penetration test
